reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial pass over all 38 questions: checked complete German sentences, the correct grammatical form, every offered option, bilingual hints/explanations and distinct contexts. Existing GM2 production/draft objectives were inspected; no same assessable objective found for these lexical contexts. All independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approvals remain pending. Corrected krankschreiben's inherited noun gloss.
